description: This file defines a helper class `ApiTokenHelper` used to generate JWT tokens for testing API authentication, specifically for admin and normal users within functional tests.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A utility class for generating JWT tokens for different user roles used in functional testing.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user with 'Administrators' role.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no specific roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token based on username and roles, signing it with a secret key.
